Activity

Backwater Village Experience

Kerala

Discover the authentic heart of Kerala on a leisurely journey through the backwaters of Kumarakom. Cruise along peaceful canals to visit traditional villages, watch skilled toddy tappers climb coconut palms, observe the age-old process of coir making from coconut husks, and see local fishermen using traditional fishing methods. This is one our responsible tourism projects where you directly contribute to the welfare of the local community. They entire activity is operated by the community, you will village residents, learn about their daily routines, and gain a genuine insight into the culture, heritage, and unhurried way of life that has flourished along Kerala's backwaters for generations.



This experience can be tailored to your wider itinerary and combined with other activities in the region. Our team will be happy to advise on timings, logistics and suitability for your party.
